genius.en: Einstein was a genius in science.
genius.cn: 爱因斯坦是科学界的天才。

genius.en: True genius often comes from hard work, not just talent.
genius.cn: 真正的天才往往源于努力，而不仅是天赋。

philosopher.en: The philosopher taught people how to live well.
philosopher.cn: 这位哲学家教导人们如何好好生活。

philosopher.en: Ancient philosophers asked deep questions about life and the world.
philosopher.cn: 古代哲学家提出了关于人生和世界的深刻问题。

influence.en: His ideas still influence us today.
influence.cn: 他的思想至今仍影响着我们。

influence.en: The wise man's influence has lasted for thousands of years.
influence.cn: 这位智者的影响力延续了数千年。

virtue.cn: 善良是一种重要的美德。

virtue.en: Ancient thinkers believed virtue was more valuable than wealth.
virtue.cn: 古代思想家认为美德比财富更可贵。

respect.en: A humble scholar earns respect through his wisdom, not his power.
respect.cn: 谦逊的学者靠智慧而非权力赢得尊敬。

wisdom.en: We can learn wisdom from old stories.
wisdom.cn: 我们能从古老的故事中学到智慧。

wisdom.en: The wisdom of ancient thinkers still guides us today.
wisdom.cn: 古代思想家的智慧至今仍指引着我们。

disciple.en: He is a disciple of the master.
The disciples wrote down their teacher's wise words.
disciple.cn: 弟子们记下了老师的智慧之言。

scholar.en: The scholar studied ancient books for years.
scholar.cn: 这位学者钻研古书多年。

scholar.en: A respected scholar shares his knowledge with the whole world.
scholar.cn: 一位受人尊敬的学者会把知识分享给全世界。

humble.en: Even with great knowledge, the scholar remained humble all his life.
humble.cn: 尽管学识渊博，这位学者一生都保持谦逊。

quote.en: This famous quote teaches us to learn from our mistakes.
quote.cn: 这句名言教导我们从错误中学习。

ancient.en: Ancient thinkers left us a great legacy of wisdom.
ancient.cn: 古代思想家给我们留下了宝贵的智慧遗产。

dynasty.en: Many wise men lived in the Han Dynasty.
Each dynasty in history produced its own famous thinkers.
dynasty.cn: 历史上每个朝代都产生了自己著名的思想家。

thinker.cn: 伟大的思想家改变世界。

thinker.en: The ideas of great thinkers still influence how we live.
thinker.cn: 伟大思想家的理念至今仍影响着我们的生活方式。

knowledge.cn: 我们通过阅读获取知识。

knowledge.en: A true scholar shares his knowledge to help others grow.
knowledge.cn: 真正的学者会分享知识以帮助他人成长。

legacy.en: Their wisdom is a legacy for us.
legacy.cn: 他们的智慧是留给我们的遗产。

legacy.en: The legacy of ancient thinkers lives on in our culture today.
legacy.cn: 古代思想家的传承至今仍存活于我们的文化中。

invention.en: The phone is a great invention.

invention.cn: 他的发明改变了人们的生活。

invention.en: Many famous inventions came after years of failed experiments.
invention.cn: 许多著名的发明都是在多年失败的实验后才诞生的。

discover.en: I want to discover new things.

discover.cn: 科学家发现了一颗新行星。

discover.en: Curious minds often discover what others have missed.
discover.cn: 好奇的头脑常常发现别人忽略的东西。

experiment.en: After many experiments, she finally proved her theory.
experiment.cn: 经过许多次实验，她终于证明了自己的理论。

curious.en: A curious child asks many questions.
curious.cn: 好奇的孩子会问很多问题。

curious.en: Great scientists are curious about everything around them.
curious.cn: 伟大的科学家对周围的一切都充满好奇。

laboratory.en: The scientist spends all day in the laboratory.
laboratory.cn: 这位科学家整天待在实验室里。

laboratory.en: Many great discoveries were made in a quiet laboratory.
laboratory.cn: 许多伟大的发现都是在安静的实验室里诞生的。

patient.en: A good scientist must be patient.
patient.cn: 一名好科学家必须有耐心。

patient.en: She was patient enough to repeat the experiment a hundred times.
patient.cn: 她有足够的耐心把实验重复了一百次。

failure.en: Failure is the mother of success.
Every failure taught the inventor something new and useful.
failure.cn: 每一次失败都教给这位发明家一些新的、有用的东西。

succeed.cn: 他努力工作并取得了成功。

succeed.en: Those who never give up will succeed in the end.
succeed.cn: 永不放弃的人最终会成功。

theory.cn: 爱因斯坦的理论改变了科学。

theory.en: A good theory must be proved by careful experiments.
theory.cn: 好的理论必须通过细致的实验来证明。

achievement.en: Landing on the moon was a huge achievement.
achievement.cn: 登上月球是一项巨大的成就。

achievement.en: Her greatest achievement was inspiring young scientists.
achievement.cn: 她最大的成就是激励了年轻的科学家。

talent.en: She has a talent for music.
His talent showed at an early age.
talent.cn: 他的天赋在很小的时候就显现了。

talent.en: Talent without hard work seldom leads to great achievement.
talent.cn: 没有努力的天赋很少能带来伟大的成就。

determined.en: She was determined to finish the work.
A determined mind can overcome almost any difficulty.
determined.cn: 坚定的意志几乎能战胜任何困难。

prize.en: He got a prize for his invention.
The Nobel Prize is given for great contributions to humankind.
prize.cn: 诺贝尔奖颁给为人类做出巨大贡献的人。

inspire.cn: 她的故事激励着年轻人。

inspire.en: Great scientists inspire others to keep asking questions.
inspire.cn: 伟大的科学家激励他人不断追问。

contribution.en: She made a great contribution to science.
contribution.cn: 她对科学做出了巨大贡献。

contribution.en: His contributions to medicine saved millions of lives.
contribution.cn: 他对医学的贡献拯救了数百万人的生命。

environment.en: A clean environment keeps us healthy.
environment.cn: 干净的环境让我们健康。

environment.en: Everyone should help protect the environment from pollution.
environment.cn: 每个人都应该帮助保护环境免受污染。

pollution.en: We must reduce pollution to protect our neighbourhood.
pollution.cn: 我们必须减少污染来保护我们的社区。

damage.en: Air pollution does serious damage to people's health.
damage.cn: 空气污染对人们的健康造成严重损害。

waste.en: We should not throw waste into rivers.
waste.cn: 我们不应把垃圾扔进河里。

waste.en: Sorting waste makes it easier to recycle and reduce pollution.
waste.cn: 垃圾分类让回收和减少污染更容易。

reduce.en: We should reduce the use of plastic.
reduce.cn: 我们应该减少塑料的使用。

reduce.en: Riding a bike can reduce both pollution and traffic.
reduce.cn: 骑自行车既能减少污染也能减少交通拥堵。

recycle.en: Recycling rubbish saves energy and protects the environment.
recycle.cn: 回收垃圾节约能源并保护环境。

survey.cn: 这次调查是关于回收的。

survey.en: Our survey showed that most citizens care about the environment.
survey.cn: 我们的调查显示大多数公民关心环境。

questionnaire.en: We sent a questionnaire to every family.
questionnaire.cn: 我们给每个家庭发了一份问卷。

questionnaire.en: The questionnaire asked people how they sort their rubbish.
questionnaire.cn: 这份问卷询问人们如何给垃圾分类。

neighbourhood.en: I live in a quiet neighbourhood.
neighbourhood.cn: 我住在一个安静的街区。

neighbourhood.en: Our neighbourhood is clean and green.
neighbourhood.cn: 我们的社区干净又绿色。

neighbourhood.en: The citizens worked together to keep their neighbourhood clean.
neighbourhood.cn: 居民们齐心协力保持社区整洁。

rubbish.en: Put the rubbish in the bin.
If everyone sorts their rubbish, recycling becomes much easier.
rubbish.cn: 如果每个人都给垃圾分类，回收就会容易得多。

bin.en: There are three bins for sorting.
Different bins help us separate paper, plastic and food waste.
bin.cn: 不同的垃圾箱帮助我们分开纸、塑料和厨余垃圾。

citizen.cn: 每个公民都应该保护自然。

citizen.en: Good citizens take responsibility for their public environment.
citizen.cn: 好公民对公共环境负起责任。

public.en: Protecting public spaces is the duty of every citizen.
public.cn: 保护公共空间是每个公民的责任。

destroy.en: Cutting down trees destroys the homes of wild animals.
destroy.cn: 砍伐树木毁掉了野生动物的家园。

protect.cn: 我们必须保护我们的河流。

protect.en: It is our duty to protect the environment for future generations.
protect.cn: 保护环境、造福后代是我们的责任。

solution.en: There is a solution to every problem.
solution.cn: 每个问题都有解决办法。

solution.en: Clean energy is one solution to global warming.
solution.cn: 清洁能源是应对全球变暖的一个办法。

global.en: Global problems need every country to work together.
global.cn: 全球性问题需要每个国家共同努力。

warming.en: Global warming is caused mainly by burning coal and oil.
warming.cn: 全球变暖主要由燃烧煤和石油造成。

carbon.en: Using clean energy lowers the carbon we put into the air.
carbon.cn: 使用清洁能源能降低我们排入空气中的碳。

emission.en: Lower emissions can slow down global warming.
emission.cn: 降低排放能减缓全球变暖。

energy.en: Renewable energy helps us protect the environment.
energy.cn: 可再生能源帮助我们保护环境。

renewable.en: Renewable energy from the sun and wind will never run out.
renewable.cn: 来自太阳和风的可再生能源永不枯竭。

solar.en: Solar panels turn sunlight into power.
solar.cn: 太阳能板把阳光变成电力。

solar.en: Many homes now use solar power instead of coal.
solar.cn: 如今许多家庭用太阳能而非煤炭发电。

electric.cn: 电动车产生的污染更少。

electric.en: Electric buses are a clean solution for busy cities.
electric.cn: 电动公交车是繁忙城市的清洁解决方案。

forest.en: Protecting forests helps many species survive.
forest.cn: 保护森林有助于许多物种生存。

species.cn: 许多物种处于危险之中。

species.en: When forests disappear, whole species can become extinct.
species.cn: 森林消失时，整个物种都可能灭绝。

extinct.en: Some animals became extinct long ago.
extinct.cn: 有些动物很久以前就灭绝了。

extinct.en: Without protection, many species may soon become extinct.
extinct.cn: 没有保护，许多物种可能很快灭绝。

landfill.cn: 垃圾填埋场堆满了废物。

landfill.en: Recycling more rubbish means we need fewer landfills.
landfill.cn: 回收更多垃圾意味着我们需要更少的填埋场。

campaign.en: The campaign asks people to save water.
campaign.cn: 这场运动呼吁人们节约用水。

campaign.en: The green campaign encouraged everyone to plant trees.
campaign.cn: 这场环保运动鼓励每个人种树。

volunteer.en: Many volunteers joined the campaign to protect the environment.
volunteer.cn: 许多志愿者加入了保护环境的运动。

film.en: The film won an award for its touching story.
film.cn: 这部电影因感人的故事获奖。

director.en: The director made many great films.
director.cn: 这位导演拍了许多优秀的电影。

director.en: A talented director can turn a simple story into a great film.
director.cn: 一位有才华的导演能把简单的故事拍成佳片。

actor.en: The actor played the hero well.
actor.cn: 这位演员把英雄演得很好。

actor.en: A good actor makes the audience believe the character is real.
actor.cn: 好演员能让观众相信角色是真实的。

actress.en: The talented actress moved the whole audience to tears.
actress.cn: 这位有才华的女演员让全场观众落泪。

character.en: The main character is very brave.
A good film has characters that feel like real people.
character.cn: 好电影里的角色让人感觉像真实的人。

scene.en: The final scene of the film made everyone cry.
scene.cn: 电影的最后一幕让所有人都哭了。

plot.en: The film has an exciting plot.
A clever plot keeps the audience guessing until the end.
plot.cn: 巧妙的情节让观众一直猜到最后。

review.en: Critics' reviews can help people decide which film to watch.
review.cn: 影评人的评论能帮人们决定看哪部电影。

produce.en: It took a year to produce this film.
produce.cn: 制作这部电影花了一年时间。

produce.en: It costs a lot of money to produce a big action film.
produce.cn: 制作一部大型动作片需要花很多钱。

release.en: The film will be released soon.
The new film was released last week.
release.cn: 这部新电影上周上映了。

release.en: The film was released around the world on the same day.
release.cn: 这部电影在全球同日上映。

cinema.en: The cinema was full last night.
We went to the cinema to watch the newly released film.
cinema.cn: 我们去电影院看新上映的电影。

audience.en: The touching ending made the whole audience cry.
audience.cn: 感人的结局让全场观众落泪。

award.cn: 这部电影获得了许多奖项。

award.en: The director received an award for his best film ever.
award.cn: 这位导演凭他最好的作品获得了一个奖项。

talented.en: The talented young director surprised the whole film world.
talented.cn: 这位有才华的年轻导演震惊了整个电影界。

touching.en: The film has a touching ending.
touching.cn: 这部电影有个感人的结局。

touching.en: The touching scene stayed in the audience's mind for a long time.
touching.cn: 这感人的一幕久久留在观众心中。

entertainment.en: A concert is a kind of entertainment.
Live entertainment brings people together for a night of fun.
entertainment.cn: 现场娱乐让人们相聚共度欢乐之夜。

concert.en: Thousands of fans came to the band's concert at the stadium.
concert.cn: 成千上万的粉丝来到体育场看乐队的演唱会。

singer.en: The singer has a lovely voice.
The famous singer sang her best song on stage.
singer.cn: 这位著名歌手在舞台上唱了她最好的歌。

band.en: The band's performance got loud applause from the audience.
band.cn: 乐队的表演赢得了观众热烈的掌声。

stage.en: The singer walked onto the stage.
When the lights came up, the band appeared on the stage.
stage.cn: 灯光亮起时，乐队出现在舞台上。

perform.en: The band performed their new song.
perform.cn: 乐队表演了他们的新歌。

perform.en: The singer performed beautifully in front of thousands of fans.
perform.cn: 歌手在数千名粉丝面前精彩地表演。

performance.cn: 她的表演赢得了热烈的掌声。

performance.en: The band's performance was the best part of the whole show.
performance.cn: 乐队的表演是整场演出最精彩的部分。

ticket.en: The concert tickets sold out fast.
Fans waited all night to buy tickets for the concert.
ticket.cn: 粉丝们彻夜等候购买演唱会的门票。

microphone.en: The singer spoke into the microphone.
Her voice filled the stadium through the microphone.
microphone.cn: 她的声音通过麦克风响彻整个体育场。

lyrics.en: The lyrics tell a sad story.
lyrics.cn: 这歌词讲了一个悲伤的故事。

lyrics.en: The beautiful lyrics made the whole audience sing along.
lyrics.cn: 优美的歌词让全场观众跟着唱起来。

melody.en: The song has a lovely melody.
A simple melody can stay in your heart for years.
melody.cn: 简单的旋律能在你心中留存多年。

stadium.en: The concert was held in a stadium.
The stadium was filled with fans cheering for the band.
stadium.cn: 体育场里挤满了为乐队欢呼的粉丝。

record.en: The band recorded a new album.
record.cn: 乐队录制了一张新专辑。

record.en: The singer spent a month recording her latest songs.
record.cn: 这位歌手花了一个月录制她最新的歌曲。

applaud.en: Everyone stood up to applaud the wonderful performance.
applaud.cn: 所有人都起立为精彩的表演鼓掌。

explore.en: Brave explorers travel far to explore the unknown world.
explore.cn: 勇敢的探险家远行去探索未知的世界。

explorer.en: The explorer reached the South Pole.
explorer.cn: 这位探险家抵达了南极。

explorer.en: The brave explorer searched the ocean depths for new species.
explorer.cn: 这位勇敢的探险家在深海中搜寻新物种。

discovery.en: Their discovery helped us understand the deep ocean better.
discovery.cn: 他们的发现帮助我们更好地了解深海。

submarine.en: A submarine can travel under the sea.
The submarine took the crew to the bottom of the ocean.
submarine.cn: 潜水艇把全体船员带到了海底。

crew.en: The brave crew faced great danger during the mission.
crew.cn: 勇敢的船员们在任务中面对巨大的危险。

mission.en: Their mission was to explore the deep sea.
mission.cn: 他们的任务是探索深海。

mission.en: The dangerous mission required courage and careful planning.
mission.cn: 这项危险的任务需要勇气和周密的计划。

depth.cn: 很少有人能到达这样的深度。

depth.en: At great depths, the water pressure is very strong.
depth.cn: 在很深的地方，水压非常强。

pressure.en: The submarine must be strong to stand the deep-sea pressure.
pressure.cn: 潜水艇必须坚固才能承受深海的压力。

unknown.en: Brave people are always ready to face the unknown.
unknown.cn: 勇敢的人总是准备好面对未知。

equipment.en: Modern equipment helps explorers search the deep ocean safely.
equipment.cn: 现代设备帮助探险家安全地搜寻深海。

signal.cn: 潜水艇发出了一个信号。

signal.en: The crew lost the signal deep under the sea.
signal.cn: 船员们在深海中失去了信号。

search.en: The team searched for days before finding the lost ship.
search.cn: 团队搜寻了好几天才找到失踪的船。

mystery.en: The deep sea is full of mysteries.
Explorers hope to solve the mysteries of the unknown world.
mystery.cn: 探险家希望解开未知世界的谜团。

brave.en: It is brave to explore the deep sea.
Only brave explorers dare to enter the unknown world.
brave.cn: 只有勇敢的探险家才敢进入未知的世界。

universe.en: Scientists believe the universe is still growing larger.
universe.cn: 科学家相信宇宙仍在不断变大。

galaxy.cn: 宇宙中有数十亿个星系。

galaxy.en: Our Earth is just a tiny part of one huge galaxy.
galaxy.cn: 我们的地球只是一个巨大星系中的小小一部分。

planet.cn: 火星是一颗红色的行星。

planet.en: Scientists search for planets that might support life.
planet.cn: 科学家寻找可能支持生命的行星。

asteroid.en: An asteroid is a space rock.
asteroid.cn: 小行星是太空中的岩石。

asteroid.en: An asteroid flew past the Earth.
Scientists watch asteroids that come close to our planet.
asteroid.cn: 科学家监测靠近我们星球的小行星。

telescope.en: We look at stars through a telescope.
A powerful telescope lets us see far into the universe.
telescope.cn: 强大的望远镜让我们能看到宇宙深处。

astronaut.en: Astronauts train for years to explore the universe safely.
astronaut.cn: 宇航员训练多年才能安全地探索宇宙。

spacecraft.en: The spacecraft sent amazing pictures back from deep space.
spacecraft.cn: 航天器从深空传回了惊人的照片。

artificial.en: Artificial intelligence may one day explore space for us.
artificial.cn: 人工智能也许有一天会替我们探索太空。

intelligence.en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we explore the universe.
intelligence.cn: 人工智能正在改变我们探索宇宙的方式。

robot.en: A robot was sent to Mars.
robot.cn: 一个机器人被送往火星。

robot.en: Robots can explore places that are too dangerous for humans.
robot.cn: 机器人能探索对人类来说太危险的地方。

imagine.en: Can you imagine life on Mars?
imagine.cn: 你能想象火星上的生活吗？

imagine.en: It is hard to imagine just how big the universe really is.
imagine.cn: 很难想象宇宙究竟有多大。

impossible.cn: 太空旅行曾经看似不可能。

impossible.en: What seems impossible today may become possible tomorrow.
impossible.cn: 今天看似不可能的事明天也许会变成可能。

surprise.en: The universe is full of surprises.
Every new discovery in space brings another surprise.
surprise.cn: 太空中每一个新发现都带来又一个惊喜。

possibility.en: Life on other planets is a possibility.
possibility.cn: 其他行星上有生命是有可能的。

possibility.en: Scientists study the possibility of finding life in space.
possibility.cn: 科学家研究在太空中找到生命的可能性。

human.en: One day humans may travel to faraway planets.
human.cn: 有一天人类也许会前往遥远的行星。
